description:
Check where a message got to: queued, sent, delivered, read, failed.

Status only moves forward. A failed status always carries an error
code, and for a few media and reaction problems it also carries a hint
naming the field to change; most failures give the code alone. Read the
code before retrying, because most failures repeat identically.

message_id.description: Message id (`msg_…`), as returned by a send or by `list_messages`.
message_id.title: Message Id

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

name: get_message_status
title: Get a message's delivery status
